metadata.description: pablolok's Claude Code skills — one plugin per skill, the same skills skill-manager installs.

plugins.name: backlog
plugins.description: Track a project's work in BACKLOG.md with doc folders archived on close; ships the doc gates and a two-way GitHub Issues mirror.

plugins.name: compliance-audit-angular
plugins.description: A specialized compliance audit for Angular applications and Angular TypeScript UI code.

plugins.name: compliance-audit-avalonia
plugins.description: A specialized compliance audit for Avalonia UI applications and Avalonia .NET desktop code.

plugins.name: compliance-audit-csharp
plugins.description: A specialized compliance audit for C# and .NET projects. Enforces architectural patterns like TDD, Dependency Injection, and the Repository Pattern for .cs files.

plugins.name: compliance-audit-frontend-styling
plugins.description: A specialized compliance audit for cross-framework frontend styling systems. Enforces reusable styling primitives, design tokens, selector discipline, and accessibility-aware CSS/SCSS practices across Angular, React, Vue, Svelte, and other web UI stacks.

plugins.name: compliance-audit-orchestrator
plugins.description: Use when finalizing an implementation phase in a Conductor track to invoke the generic verification-gate audit first, then determine and invoke the correct specialized compliance audit (C#, Scripts, Angular, Avalonia UI, or Frontend Styling) based on the files modified.

plugins.name: compliance-audit-scripts
plugins.description: A specialized compliance audit for automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash). Enforces best practices for cross-platform safety, idempotency, and TDD in script files.

plugins.name: compliance-audit-verification-gates
plugins.description: A generic compliance audit that verifies required automated verification gates passed before manual verification.

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Context-Driven Development for Claude Code. Installs the /conductor:* slash commands and scaffolds the conductor/ workspace (product, tech-stack, workflow, tracks) so a project is managed through spec-first tracks, phase checkpoints, and git-notes audit trails.

plugins.name: conductor-workflow-optimization
plugins.description: Detect and remediate Claude Code Conductor workflow drift caused by stale tool names, invalid plan-mode transitions, unexpected tool calls, and CLI/workflow mismatches.

plugins.name: pre-implementation-review
plugins.description: Review planned work before implementation to identify reuse opportunities, existing abstractions, duplication risks, and the right reusable boundary.

plugins.name: review-backlog
plugins.description: Periodic review of the backlog: run the document gates, clean up what has rotted, close with ONE proposal of what to do next.

plugins.name: review-optimization
plugins.description: Use after a phase completion but before final user verification to analyze execution history, audit skill efficiency, and suggest workflow optimizations.

plugins.name: skill-retrospective
plugins.description: When a piece of work closes, rewrite the skills it used in place with what it taught; two hooks log the skills used and ask for the retrospective.

plugins.name: subagent-balancer
plugins.description: Quota-aware routing for Claude Code and Claude subscription subagent delegation with fallback-to-local execution.

plugins.name: subagent-balancer-api
plugins.description: Price-aware routing for Anthropic API (Claude API) model selection with cost-quality tradeoff guidance.

plugins.name: subagent-balancer-orchestrator
plugins.description: Routes Claude delegation to the correct balancing policy for CLI quota preservation versus API cost preservation.
